questions.body_en: Find the missing number in the sequence: 2, 2, 4, 6, 10, ( ), 42, …
questions.body_id: Temukan bilangan yang hilang dalam barisan berikut: 2, 2, 4, 6, 10, ( ), 42, …

questions.body_en: Cindy scored the following for five tests: 97, 99, 96, 93, 95. What is her average score?
questions.body_id: Cindy mendapat nilai berikut untuk lima tes: 97, 99, 96, 93, 95. Berapakah nilai rata-ratanya?

questions.body_en: There are 15 children at a party. Each boy gets 2 balloons, while each girl gets 3 balloons. Altogether, 37 balloons are given out. How many boys are there?
questions.body_id: Ada 15 anak di sebuah pesta. Setiap anak laki-laki mendapat 2 balon, sedangkan setiap anak perempuan mendapat 3 balon. Seluruhnya, 37 balon dibagikan. Berapa banyak anak laki-laki?

questions.body_en: Which figure best replaces the question mark?
questions.body_id: Gambar manakah yang paling tepat menggantikan tanda tanya?

questions.body_en: How many triangles are there in the figure?
questions.body_id: Berapa banyak segitiga yang terdapat dalam gambar?

questions.body_en: The area of a square is given as Side × Side. Find the area of square ABCD if the area of the shaded region (the tilted inner square) is 16 cm².
questions.body_id: Luas persegi dinyatakan sebagai Sisi × Sisi. Temukan luas persegi ABCD jika luas daerah yang diarsir (persegi miring di dalamnya) adalah 16 cm².

questions.body_en: The balance scales show fruit relationships. Given the two balance conditions shown, find how many peaches balance with 2 mangoes.
questions.body_id: Timbangan menunjukkan hubungan antara buah-buahan. Berdasarkan dua kondisi timbangan yang ditunjukkan, temukan berapa buah persik yang seimbang dengan 2 mangga.

questions.body_en: Shawn is 9 years old. He asks his cousin for her age. She replies, "When you reach my age, I will be 35 years old." How old is Shawn's cousin?
questions.body_id: Shawn berumur 9 tahun. Ia bertanya kepada sepupunya tentang usianya. Sepupunya menjawab, "Ketika kamu mencapai usiaku, aku akan berumur 35 tahun." Berapa umur sepupu Shawn?

questions.body_en: Each shape (triangle and circle inside shapes) is assigned a value. Based on the patterns shown (green triangle with yellow inner triangle = 11; grey circle with green inner square = 23; green square with red inner triangle = 31; yellow square with purple inner square = 33; blue triangle with peach inner circle = 12), what number does AB represent for the purple square with yellow inner circle?
questions.body_id: Setiap bentuk (segitiga dan lingkaran di dalam bentuk lain) memiliki nilai. Berdasarkan pola yang ditunjukkan, berapakah nilai AB untuk persegi ungu dengan lingkaran kuning di dalamnya?

questions.body_en: Chandni and his sister were 250 m apart in the park. They began walking towards each other at a speed of 25 and 30 metres per minute, respectively. How far apart were they after 4 minutes?
questions.body_id: Chandni dan adiknya berada 250 m berjauhan di taman. Mereka mulai berjalan saling mendekati dengan kecepatan masing-masing 25 dan 30 meter per menit. Seberapa jauh jarak mereka setelah 4 menit?

questions.body_en: Michelle asks her aunt, "How old are you?" Her aunt replies, "When I was your age, you were only 3 years old. By the time you reach my age, I will be 39." How old is Michelle's aunt?
questions.body_id: Michelle bertanya kepada bibinya, "Berapa umurmu?" Bibinya menjawab, "Ketika aku seusiamu, kamu baru berumur 3 tahun. Saat kamu mencapai usiaku, aku akan berumur 39." Berapa umur bibi Michelle?

questions.body_en: A number leaves a remainder of 2 when divided by 3. It leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by 4. What is the remainder it leaves when divided by 12?
questions.body_id: Suatu bilangan bersisa 2 jika dibagi 3. Bilangan itu bersisa 1 jika dibagi 4. Berapakah sisa jika bilangan itu dibagi 12?

questions.body_en: A, B and C are balls of different weights. Three balance scale figures are shown: Fig. 1 shows 5A balancing 3B; Fig. 2 shows 1A balancing 2B and 1C (with C on top of B); Fig. 3 shows 6A on one side and 4B on the other (unbalanced). In Fig. 3, what must be added to the pan on the right-hand side to make it balanced?
questions.body_id: A, B dan C adalah bola dengan berat berbeda. Tiga gambar timbangan ditunjukkan: Gambar 1 menunjukkan 5A seimbang dengan 3B; Gambar 2 menunjukkan 1A seimbang dengan 2B dan 1C; Gambar 3 menunjukkan 6A di satu sisi dan 4B di sisi lain (tidak seimbang). Pada Gambar 3, apa yang harus ditambahkan ke piring sisi kanan agar seimbang?

questions.body_en: A game of numbers involves 2 players and 2017 beads. At every turn, a player must remove between 1 to 4 beads. The player who is left with the last bead loses. How many beads must the first player remove at the start of the game in order to win?
questions.body_id: Sebuah permainan melibatkan 2 pemain dan 2017 manik-manik. Setiap giliran, seorang pemain harus mengambil antara 1 hingga 4 manik-manik. Pemain yang tersisa dengan manik-manik terakhir kalah. Berapa manik-manik yang harus diambil pemain pertama di awal permainan agar menang?

questions.body_en: At first, the amount of milk in Barrel A was twice that in Barrel B. After 20 litres of milk was removed from each barrel, the amount of milk in Barrel A was thrice that in Barrel B. What was the amount of milk (in litres) in Barrels A and B, respectively, at the beginning?
questions.body_id: Mula-mula, jumlah susu dalam Tong A dua kali lipat jumlah dalam Tong B. Setelah 20 liter susu diambil dari masing-masing tong, jumlah susu dalam Tong A menjadi tiga kali lipat Tong B. Berapakah jumlah susu (dalam liter) dalam Tong A dan Tong B masing-masing pada awalnya?

questions.body_en: The figure shows a square of sides 10 cm. The area of rectangle EFGH is 8 cm². Find the area of the quadrilateral ABCD in cm².
questions.body_id: Gambar menunjukkan persegi dengan sisi 10 cm. Luas persegi panjang EFGH adalah 8 cm². Temukan luas segiempat ABCD dalam cm².

questions.body_en: The figure shows 2 squares ABCD and DEFG. The length of the sides are 5 cm and 3 cm, respectively. Find the area of the shaded region ACEF in cm².
questions.body_id: Gambar menunjukkan 2 persegi ABCD dan DEFG. Panjang sisinya masing-masing 5 cm dan 3 cm. Temukan luas daerah yang diarsir ACEF dalam cm².

questions.body_en: Shi Ting's piano examination is coming. In order to motivate her, her mom will give her 8 chocolate bars on days she practices 30 minutes or more. She will be given only 5 chocolate bars if she practices for less than 30 minutes on any particular day. Suppose she practices for 18 days and has earned a total of 53 chocolate bars, on how many days did she fall short of the 30-minute mark?
questions.body_id: Ujian piano Shi Ting sudah dekat. Untuk memotivasinya, ibunya akan memberikan 8 batang cokelat pada hari-hari ia berlatih 30 menit atau lebih. Ia hanya mendapat 5 batang cokelat jika berlatih kurang dari 30 menit pada hari tertentu. Misalkan ia berlatih selama 18 hari dan mendapat total 53 batang cokelat, berapa hari ia tidak mencapai tanda 30 menit?

questions.body_en: In 2017, 5th August falls on a Saturday. On which day of the week will 1st January 2018 fall?
questions.body_id: Pada tahun 2017, tanggal 5 Agustus jatuh pada hari Sabtu. Pada hari apa tanggal 1 Januari 2018 jatuh?

questions.body_en: A car travelled from Town A to Town B at a speed of 90 km/h. It then returned at a speed of 60 km/h. What was the average speed of the car for the whole trip?
questions.body_id: Sebuah mobil melaju dari Kota A ke Kota B dengan kecepatan 90 km/jam. Kemudian kembali dengan kecepatan 60 km/jam. Berapakah kecepatan rata-rata mobil untuk seluruh perjalanan?

questions.body_en: A, B and C are three consecutive whole numbers such that A × B × C = 504. Find the value of A.
questions.body_id: A, B dan C adalah tiga bilangan bulat berurutan sehingga A × B × C = 504. Temukan nilai A.

questions.body_en: How many ways are there to put 2 beads on a 3 × 3 grid, so that they do not lie on the same line?
questions.body_id: Berapa banyak cara untuk menempatkan 2 manik-manik pada kisi 3 × 3 sehingga keduanya tidak terletak pada garis yang sama?

questions.body_en: In △ABC, AD = (1/2)DB and CE = (1/4)CB. Given that the area of △CDE is 9 cm², find the area of △ABC in cm².
questions.body_id: Dalam △ABC, AD = (1/2)DB dan CE = (1/4)CB. Diketahui luas △CDE adalah 9 cm², temukan luas △ABC dalam cm².
